subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped action revisions be accepted for the secret-bearing security, publishing, token, and Codex-agent workflows after an exact-head validation pass?
rationale: The diff has no discrete code defect, but approval changes trusted executable dependencies at multiple privileged workflow boundaries and therefore requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Owner-audit and merge
options.body: Have security and release-automation owners verify the upstream revisions, rerun the affected exact head, and merge if the attributable checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, and Codex Action updates into smaller PRs if owners want independent rollout and rollback boundaries.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Pause the refresh and keep the existing revisions if the grouped audit or exact-head workflow proof cannot be completed safely.

recommendation.title: Owner-audit and merge
recommendation.body: Have security and release-automation owners verify the upstream revisions, rerun the affected exact head, and merge if the attributable checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns several changed security workflows to this team, making it the strongest available owner for the security-boundary decision.
